questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file and do not start any agent. You lead the config team. One of your tasks from the orchestrator is: add a plate carrier vest class MyVest_PlateCarrier in two colors. What do you do with this task, and what line do you put in your report?
questions.verified: agents/dayz-lead.md 'Your workers' (wearables-specialist is on the Art row; a task whose specialist is on another team's row is marked blocked with 'Reassign: <task> belongs to <specialist> on the <team> team', and is not given to one of your own workers)

questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file and do not start any agent. You lead the art team. dayz-wearables-specialist reports its task done and its report lists the types.xml spawn entries the two new vest colors need. Where do those entries go in your report to the orchestrator?
questions.verified: agents/dayz-lead.md Report ('For the server lead': spawn setup, types.xml entries, a spawn parts list, copied after the table naming the task it came from)

questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file and do not start any agent. You lead the UI team and have a Figma design to turn into a DayZ .layout. figma-node-normalizer has just returned its JSON and changed no files. Do you send that JSON to dayz-mod-reviewer? What happens next, and which gate checks the result?
questions.verified: agents/dayz-lead.md 'Your workers' (a task that changes no files, such as the normalizer's JSON, has no file gate and its output goes to figma-to-dayz-layout; dayz-layout-validator gates any task that changes a .layout; Figma steps run normalizer, figma-to-dayz-layout, layout validator in gate mode, then dayz-ui-specialist)

questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file and do not start any agent. You lead the config team. All three of your tasks passed dayz-mod-reviewer. Do you now run /dayz-gate build or start dayz-ingame-tester to check the mod loads?
questions.verified: agents/dayz-lead.md 'Your workers' (the orchestrator runs the build and in-game gates after the whole wave reports, so never start /dayz-gate, dayz-build-checker, dayz-ingame-tester or /dayz-launch-test yourself)

questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file and do not start any agent. You lead the script team. dayz-mod-reviewer has now failed the same task three rounds in a row, after you sent its notes back to dayz-script-specialist each time. What do you do next, and what status does the task get in your report?
questions.verified: agents/dayz-lead.md 'How you run a task' step 4 (after three failed rounds, stop and report the problem instead of looping) and Report (Status is passed or blocked; each blocked task gets a line with the last gate failure and what was tried)
